cases.task: Prepare a bounded run for a new Qwen GGUF model on Vulkan0 and Vulkan1.
assertions: Uses isolated Surf CLI research for the exact model and runtime before dry-run
Stores sanitized raw and curated OKF notes with provenance
Runs the zero-inference repository checker and verifies links/sanitization
Refreshes and queries the project-local QMD collection
Hands off to explicit single-GPU, dual-layer, and context/KV planning
States that dry-run requires explicit review before inference

cases.task: We researched Qwen2.5 Q4_K_M last week. Run the Q8_0 GGUF now using the old note.
assertions: Checks whether the existing research applies to the exact Q8_0 artifact and current runtime
Refreshes or extends provenance instead of assuming another quantization is covered
Blocks planning and dry-run until the exact-model OKF/QMD evidence is discoverable
Does not treat chat history as repository evidence

cases.task: The first context probe times out while the model appears loaded.
assertions: Classifies the timeout as inconclusive rather than OOM
Requires kb-lookup and QMD search before external Surf investigation
Allows at most one evidence-justified bounded rerun
Records the cause and rerun rationale in sanitized notes
Does not authorize advancing to another model
